note: Which story shows which Figma skin, and how a skin's file name maps back to story args. Read by tools/onion-check.mjs. pattern names the axes in file-name order; a value of true/false is a boolean, a number is a number, 1x1 is 1/1. states: what each state axis value means as args; a state not listed here (hover, active) is CSS the story cannot force, so it is not checked.

ContactCta.doc: ContactCta is a Button with a default label and size sm, so its skins are the Figma Button's, laid over this one. Switch Onion in the toolbar; variant and size in Controls pick the skin.

ArrowCta.doc: The Figma component laid over this one. ArrowCta is a Button with an uppercase, tracked, semibold label and a trailing arrow, drawn at lg by default. Switch Onion in the toolbar; variant and size pick the skin.

HeroCarousel.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at the 1024px width it was drawn at, slides one to three (the Slide variants). The plate is the kit's stock placeholder (the same image is in the design), so what is compared is the scrim, the copy, the CTA and the pager. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

TileGrid.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px, nine tiles as the grid lays them out (four to a row: columns is a minimum tile width). The stock plates are the same images in the design, so what is compared is the card, its radii, the type and the grid. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

HubCards.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: four cards as the grid lays them (three to a row, then one: columns is a minimum card width), each the height of its row, the footer rule and link pinned to the bottom. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

CtaBlocks.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: an inverse block with an outline ArrowCta and a sunken block with a solid one, the button radius the concentric remainder of the block's. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

MediaCards.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: three cards in a row, each a stand-in photograph, a kind chip with its icon and a duration, and a linked title. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

FilterBar.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: seven interactive chips in a wrapping row, the first pressed. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

PeopleDirectory.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: an inverse band and filter form (three fields and an outline button), then four portrait cards. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

EventList.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a heading and three rows, each with the date and place in mono above the title, an outline button at the right and a hairline under it. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

LeadForm.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: an inverse section with a 768px form (six fields in two columns, a select, a textarea, the verification alert and a button). Switch Onion in the toolbar.

ApplyForm.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at its own width (the form's measure, 517px): a heading over one column of fields, a file Field, a consent checkbox and a solid button. The file input and checkbox are the browser's own controls; the design draws stand-ins. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SegmentPage.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a PageHero, an intro, a capabilities list beside a photograph, and an inverse call to action. The skin is exported in three sections and stitched, because Figma caps an export at 1024px. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SubBrandPage.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a PageHero, a narrow column of photograph and button beside an intro and a list of facts. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

ArticlePage.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a PageHero, then a 485px reading column (kind chip and date, lede, paragraphs, a section, a flat byline card). The skin is the hero and the column exported separately and placed, because Figma caps an export at 1024px. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

FeatureGrid.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a header and three cards, each a photograph bleeding to the card's edges over a title. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

EventPromo.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a photograph beside a centred column (mono eyebrow, heading, body, date and place, a solid button). Switch Onion in the toolbar.

ArticleFeed.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: a centred header and four portrait cards with their kind and title over a dark scrim. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

HeaderSearch.doc: The Figma component laid over this one, closed and open, in the 1024px form the story gives it: the control sits at the left, one quiet icon button closed, a 224px input and the button open. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SectionNav.doc: The Figma component laid over this one, at the 720px width it was drawn at.

OnThisPage.doc: The Figma component laid over this one, at the 240px width it was drawn at.

MenuButton.doc: The Figma component laid over this one, closed and open. Open includes the list, so the box is as tall as the list under the trigger.

MegaMenu.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 1024px: the masthead with its mega panel open under it, anchored to the header and as wide as it. The frame is as tall as the open panel. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Faq.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at its own width (44rem): a heading and four entries, the first open. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SearchResults.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at the 640px it is drawn at: the toolbar (a search field and six type chips, All pressed), the count and six results. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

LogoLadder.doc: The Figma component laid over this one, a stage at a time, each in a box of the width its band starts at: 64, 120, 200, 320 and 480px. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Plate.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at the 512px it is drawn at, one ratio at a time. The height is capped at 22rem, so 4:3, 1:1 and 3:4 are the same height. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Gradient.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at 480 by 192 (12rem), a shape and a direction at a time, in the kit's wireframe pair. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Search.doc: The Figma HeaderSearch laid over this one (they are the same control: a quiet icon button that opens a 224px input), closed and open, in the 1024px box the story gives it. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SkipLink.doc: The Figma component laid over this one in its focused state (the only state there is to see): a raised box with a focus-colour border and the focus ring outside it, 8px in from the corner. The story forces the state with an inline style, because a screenshot cannot Tab. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Arrow.doc: The Figma component laid over this one at the 16px it is drawn at.

Map.doc: The Figma Map laid over this one at 480px wide. The basemap is a flat stand-in, so what is compared is the frame, its corner and the controls (zoom, fullscreen, scale, attribution, marker); a real basemap is the tile server’s drawing. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

SegmentList.doc: The Figma SegmentList laid over this one at 1024px: the copy and the audiences list on the left, the map and the reach list on the right. The map is a flat stand-in basemap (no tiles are fetched), so what is compared is the layout and the controls. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Tachometer.doc: A picture of the live dial laid over the live dial: a canvas drawn in script is not a layout Figma can draw, so the Figma component is a frozen capture in two states (72% ALIGN, and pegged at 92% MEANT). It proves the frame, size and ground, not the drawing. Switch Onion in the toolbar.

Shell.doc: The Figma Shell laid over this one at 480px (800 for split and sidebar): stack, row, grid with three fixed columns, split and sidebar, each holding the same placeholder cells at gap 4. Switch Onion in the toolbar; kind in Controls picks the skin.

Hero.doc: The Figma Hero laid over this one at 1024px, stacked and split. The plate is a captured stand-in with its corner drawn in Figma. Switch Onion in the toolbar; layout in Controls picks the skin.

error.error: Enter an email address like name@example.com.

InlineForm.doc: The Figma InlineForm laid over this one at 400px, without and with an error.

ButtonGroup.doc: The Figma ButtonGroup laid over this one: the dialog footer at 480px, end-aligned, equal widths.

ButtonReason.doc: The Figma ButtonReason laid over a disabled button with its reason label pinned open.

CardHeader.doc: The Figma CardHeader laid over a card with a header at 320px.

ChoiceCard.doc: The Figma ChoiceCard pair (unchecked, checked) laid over the live pair at 280px.
